title: Global urbanization
summary: Records of cities reach back to 3700 BC, but in AD 1800 Beijing is cited as the only city in the world with a million people. Today, by one measure, around 80% of people live in cities, towns and suburbs, and the world has been mostly urban since at least the 1950s. UN reports using national definitions announced that the world became majority urban in 2007.

importance.justification: Most people now live in urban places, a change in how humans live.

related.because: Industrial mechanization and factory employment pulled millions of agrarian workers into expanding manufacturing cities.
